rules.description: Write unit tests for backend (JUnit, Mockito)
rules.instruction: Test all service methods. Mock external dependencies. Use meaningful test names.

rules.description: Write component tests for frontend (Vitest, RTL)
rules.instruction: Test user interactions. Verify rendered output. Mock API calls.

rules.description: Create integration tests for API endpoints
rules.instruction: Test complete API flows. Use test containers for database. Verify data persistence.
Run coverage reports. Add tests for uncovered code. Focus on critical paths.
Use descriptive names: method_scenario_expectedResult. Group related tests.

rules.description: Use test containers for integration tests
rules.instruction: Spin up real database containers. Clean up after tests. Use fixed versions.
Test critical user workflows. Cover happy paths and error cases. Run in CI.
Identify flaky tests. Improve test reliability. Remove duplication.
